# Core

> Product documentation for Core, the Bitcoin Universe explorer, portfolio,
> activity, and marketplace application at https://www.bitcoinuniverse.io.
> Core reads Bitcoin and Dogecoin and the metaprotocol assets carried on them.
> It is non-custodial: keys stay in the reader's own wallet.

Core has no semantic version. Its release identifier is the exact commit a
deployment was built from, returned in the `release` field of
https://api.bitcoinuniverse.io/health and in the `X-Universe-Release` header
on every response.

The protocol registry holds 38 protocols, of which
29 have a marketplace policy: 9
enabled, 13 feature-gated, 7 read-only.
19 declare buy support and none supports the
`sell` action. Code presence is not released capability: a route existing is
not production availability, and a parser existing is not wallet support.

## Start here

- [What Core is](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/start/what-core-is/): the four surfaces, and what Core deliberately does not do.
- [Your first five minutes](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/start/first-five-minutes/): a guided walk with no wallet connected.
- [Safety in sixty seconds](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/start/safety/): the six things to know before a first transaction.
- [Reading the numbers](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/start/reading-the-numbers/): unknown is not zero, empty is not unavailable.
- [Product tour](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/start/product-tour/): real captures of the running product.

## Protocol support

- [The support matrix](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/protocols/support-matrix/): all 29 marketplace protocols against all 13 marketplace actions, generated from the Core registry.
- [How to read a protocol row](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/protocols/how-to-read/): what availability, execution mode, freshness, confirmation and reorg mean.
- [Confirmation and reorg policy](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/protocols/confirmation-and-reorg/): settlement depth and reconciliation, per protocol.
- [Indexer sources of truth](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/protocols/indexer-sources/): which index answers which question.
- [Coverage beyond the marketplace](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/protocols/coverage/): the nine protocols with no marketplace at all.

## Explorer

- [Search](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/explorer/search/): what is recognised, and the exact, likely and candidate confidence levels.
- [Blocks](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/explorer/blocks/): the verified chain tip, and why there is no block detail page.
- [Transactions](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/explorer/transactions/): the public transaction endpoint and broadcast handling.
- [Addresses](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/explorer/addresses/): confirmed and mempool totals kept apart.
- [UTXOs](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/explorer/utxos/): why the outpoint is the unit that matters.
- [Asset-bearing outputs](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/explorer/asset-bearing-outputs/): how a valid transaction destroys an asset, and what Core refuses.
- [Protocol assets](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/explorer/protocol-assets/): identity, naming, and verified media.
- [Protocol indexes](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-core/explorer/protocol-indexes/): the per-protocol catalogs.
